system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: is prompted with few-shot in-context examples to generate both domain-speciﬁc actions and free-form language thoughts for task solving
system_prompt_style.note: Paper-only; few-shot prompt per task, mechanism not described. Per rule, 'prompted with' without mechanism -> static.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: models only receive the question/claim as input without access to support paragraphs
env_context_strategy.note: Model retrieves via search/lookup actions on Wikipedia API.

context_compaction.note: Paper only; no config or run loop available to check for history compaction.

observation_format.evidence_quote: search[entity], which returns the ﬁrst 5 sentences from the corresponding entity wiki page
observation_format.note: search returns the first 5 sentences, a form of truncated text observation.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: (1) search[entity], which returns the ﬁrst 5 sentences
tool_call_format.note: Closest-value choice: actions are bracketed text commands (search[x], finish[x]) parsed from model output, which none of the listed values matches exactly.

tool_count.evidence_quote: We design a simple Wikipedia web API with three types of actions
tool_count.note: HotpotQA/Fever setup; ALFWorld and WebShop use their own environment-specific action spaces.

edit_primitive.note: Paper only; no tool registry available. The described tasks involve no file editing.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: we randomly select 6 and 3 cases2 from the training set and manually compose ReAct-format trajectories to use as few-shot exemplars
tool_schema_source.note: Action formats are conveyed through manually composed exemplars.

protocol_standardization.note: No code or dependency list available to check for protocol support.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: the task-solving trajectory consists of multiple thought-action-observation steps
loop_primitives.note: The paper also describes ReAct/CoT-SC back-off combinations (Sec. 3.2) as a variant.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: decomposing task goals and create action plans
planning_granularity.note: Planning happens only in free-text thoughts.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: a frozen large language model, PaLM-540B
multi_agent_topology.note: Inferred: the paper describes one model driving the loop.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: a frozen large language model, PaLM-540B
delegation_mechanism.note: Inferred from the single-model setup only; no agent factory or delegation tool was available to inspect.

human_in_loop.note: The paper mentions humans correcting behaviour through thought editing (Fig. 5), but no gating mechanism is described.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: update the contextct+1 = (ct, ˆat) to support future reasoning or acting

long_term_memory.note: Paper only; no place where long-term memory would be declared.

state_persistence.note: No code available to check for resume or persistence.

self_verification.note: No harness code available to check for verification steps.

retry_policy.note: Only the CoT-SC back-off heuristic is described, which is a method combination rather than a retry policy.

rollback.note: No code available to check for rollback.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: when ReAct fails to return an answer within given steps, back off to CoT-SC. We set 7 and 5 steps for HotpotQA and FEVER

cost_controls.note: No config available to check for cost controls.

timeouts.note: No code available to check for timeouts.

execution_isolation.note: No code available to check the execution environment.

filesystem_access.note: No code available to check filesystem access.

network_policy.note: The ethics statement says interactions were limited to specific websites by experiment design; no enforcement mechanism is described.

permission_model.note: No code available to check the permission model.

tracing.note: No code available to check tracing.

replayability.note: No code available to check replay support.

eval_hooks.note: The paper evaluates on benchmarks, but no repository was available to check for built-in eval hooks.

guardrails.note: The ethics statement describes action-space design choices, not guardrail mechanisms.
